title: PriorityAlertCriteriaGet
description: Priority Alert individual Criterion detailed settings response object containing schedule, phone numbers, and notification configurations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the priority alert criteria.

scheduleName.description: Name of the schedule associated with the criteria.

scheduleType.description:
Type of the schedule.
 * `businessHours` - Business hours schedule type.
 * `holidays` - Holidays schedule type.

scheduleLevel.description:
* `PEOPLE` - The schedule is at the user level.
 * `LOCATION` - The schedule is at the location level.

callsFrom.description:
Specifies the type of callsFrom, categorizing incoming data based on callsFrom types or numbers that match the current criteria.
 * `ANY_PHONE_NUMBER` - The criteria applies to any phone number.
* `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS` - The criteria applies to selected phone numbers.

anonymousCallersEnabled.description: Indicates whether anonymous callers are included in this criteria.

unavailableCallersEnabled.description: Indicates whether unavailable callers are included in this criteria.

phoneNumbers.description: List of phone numbers that this criteria applies to.

items.description: Phone number that the criteria applies to.

notificationEnabled.description: Determines whether priority alerting is applied for calls matching this criteria. If `true`, priority alerting is applied. If `false`, this criteria acts as a 'Don't Alert' rule, preventing priority alerting. Criteria with `notificationEnabled` set to `false` (Don't Alert) take precedence over criteria with `notificationEnabled` set to `true` (Alert).
